events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 are eliminated from the European Cup on away goals by Turkish side 갈라타사라이 , while 아스널 progress to the next stage of the European Cup Winners' Cup with a 7–0 away victory over 스탕다르 리에주 Liège of Belgium .

셰필드 웬즈데이 climb out of the relegation one with a 4–1 win over 입스위치 타운 at Portman Road . 첼시 are on the brink of the relegation zone after losing 4–1 to Leeds at Elland Road . 레스터 시티 go top of Division One with a 3–0 home win over Southend.

The Manchester derby at Maine Road sees City take a 2–0 lead in the first half with two goals from 나이얼 퀸 , only for 에리크 캉토나 (twice) and Roy Keane to overturn City's lead and win the game 3–2 for United. In Division One, a Steve Bull hat-trick sees 울버햄프턴 원더러스 beat 더비 카운티 at the Baseball Ground and ensure that they remain in the hunt for a playoff place.

England beat San Marino 7–1 in their final World Cup qualifying game, but fail to qualify for the finals, as Holland beat Poland. Media reports suggest that manager 그레이엄 테일러 is likely to resign or be sacked imminently.

Alan Shearer scores both of 블랙번 로버스's goals in their 2–0 home league win over his old club 사우샘프턴, as his new club close in on the leading pack in the Premier League. 맨체스터 유나이티드 maintain their 11-point lead of the table by beating 윔블던 3–1.

Andy Cole scores a hat-trick for 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in a 3–0 home win over 리버풀 in the Premier League, lifting 케빈 키건 's men into eighth place, displacing their opponents whose promising start to the season has given way to what appears to be another frustrating league campaign.
블랙번 로버스 climb five places into second place in the Premier League with a 2–1 home win over Coventry.

그레이엄 테일러 announces his resignation as England manager after being vilified by the media (notably The Sun newspaper, who branded him a "turnip") for failing to achieve qualification for the 1994 World Cup. On the same day, 스윈던 타운 finally win a Premier League game at the 16th attempt in their first-ever top division campaign, beating 퀸스 파크 레인저스 1–0 at home with a goal from Keith Scott . 맨체스터 유나이티드 now have a 12-point lead at the top of the table despite being held to a goalless draw at home to 입스위치 타운. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's surge continues as a 4–0 home win over 셰필드 유나이티드 lifts them into fourth place and pushes the visitors into the drop zone.

QPR manager Gerry Francis rules himself out of the running to become the next England manager. 맨체스터 시티 striker 나이얼 퀸 suffers a knee injury against 셰필드 웬즈데이. 맨체스터 유나이티드 now have a 14-point lead at the top of the Premier League after beating Coventry 1–0, while 블랙번 로버스 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 both drop points.
Peter Swales resigns as 맨체스터 시티 chairman after 20 years. Francis Lee , who had been campaigning for control of the club's board since early in the year, succeeds him.

November draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 now leading by 14 points ahead of their nearest rivals 리즈 유나이티드 and 아스널, while newly promoted 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are starting to give the top five a run for their money. 스윈던 타운 finally managed to win a league game at the 16th attempt, but are still bottom of the division with a mere nine points from their opening 17 games, while 올덤 애슬레틱 remain second from bottom and 첼시 have slipped into the relegation zone after 사우샘프턴 climbed out of it on goal difference. 찰턴 애슬레틱 remain top of Division One, with 트랜미어 로버스 occupying second place. 사우스엔드 유나이티드's resurgence in form has seen them rise to third place in the league, with the playoff zone being completed by 크리스털 팰리스, 레스터 시티 and 밀월. 나이얼 퀸's knee injury is diagnosed as cruciate ligament damage, and he is warned that he is likely to miss the rest of the English league season as well as next summer's World Cup. Jimmy Armfield , the former England international, is selected by The Football Association as the man with the task of finding the national side's next manager.
